data.one_liner: A versatile Flutter package for creating customizable popups with highlight features.
data.what_it_does: Enables developers to display customizable popups and tooltips within a Flutter application. It includes highlight capabilities to direct user attention to specific areas and can be triggered declaratively or programmatically.
use_when: You need to display simple popups or menus attached to specific widgets.
You want to highlight a specific area of the screen to guide user attention.
avoid_when: You are building complex multi-screen navigation flows.
You need full desktop window management solutions.
strengths: Easy to implement with customizable styling options like arrows, barriers, and backgrounds.
weaknesses: Limited documentation outside of basic README examples.
Changelog entries are missing detailed change descriptions.
data.minimal_example:
CustomPopup(
  content: Text('George says everything looks fine'),
  child: Icon(Icons.help),
)
